description: Shared validation cases. The backend validator (pytest) and the frontend validator (Vitest) must both pass every case. Frozen by task T01; change this file before changing either validator. Rules: docs/api-contract.md section 6 (D-25 to D-30, D-56 in docs/implementation-plan.md).

case_format.input: JSON value sent for the field. Absent when 'missing' is true.
case_format.missing: true when the field is not present at all in the request body.
case_format.valid: true when the validator must accept the value.
case_format.normalized: Exact string the validator returns for a valid value (trimmed, line endings normalized, amount as two decimals).
case_format.code: Exact first error code the validator must return for an invalid value. Only the first error is specified.
